properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.provider.allow-fallbacks
properties.description: Whether OpenRouter may route to other upstream providers when the preferred ones are unavailable.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.provider.require-parameters
properties.description: Whether to route only to upstream providers that support every parameter in the request.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.provider.data-collection
properties.description: Data collection policy that upstream providers must meet: allow or deny. Other values are sent and logged once as a warning.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.provider.order
properties.description: Comma-separated list of upstream provider slugs to try in order.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.provider.ignore
properties.description: Comma-separated list of upstream provider slugs never to route to.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.provider.quantizations
properties.description: Comma-separated list of model quantization levels to accept, such as fp8 or int4. Undocumented values are sent and logged once as a warning.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.provider.sort
properties.description: Upstream provider ordering: price, throughput, latency or exacto. Other values are sent and logged once as a warning.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.embedding.provider.allow-fallbacks
properties.description: Whether OpenRouter may route to other upstream providers when the preferred ones are unavailable.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.embedding.provider.require-parameters
properties.description: Whether to route only to upstream providers that support every parameter in the request.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.embedding.provider.data-collection
properties.description: Data collection policy that upstream providers must meet: allow or deny. Other values are sent and logged once as a warning.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.embedding.provider.order
properties.description: Comma-separated list of upstream provider slugs to try in order.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.embedding.provider.ignore
properties.description: Comma-separated list of upstream provider slugs never to route to.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.embedding.provider.quantizations
properties.description: Comma-separated list of model quantization levels to accept, such as fp8 or int4. Undocumented values are sent and logged once as a warning.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.embedding.provider.sort
properties.description: Upstream provider ordering: price, throughput, latency or exacto. Other values are sent and logged once as a warning.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.reasoning.effort
properties.description: Reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Other values are sent and logged once as a warning. Mutually exclusive with max-tokens.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.reasoning.max-tokens
properties.description: Token budget for reasoning. Mutually exclusive with effort.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.reasoning.exclude
properties.description: Whether to leave the reasoning text out of the response while the model still reasons.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.reasoning.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable reasoning with the model's default settings.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.audio.voice
properties.description: Provider-specific voice name for audio output. Streaming Chat Completions only.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.audio.format
properties.description: Audio output encoding: wav, mp3, flac, opus or pcm16.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.response-format.type
properties.description: Response format type: text, JSON object, or JSON schema for structured output.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.response-format.name
properties.description: Schema name sent with a JSON schema format. Defaults to response on the wire.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.response-format.strict
properties.description: Whether the provider must follow the JSON schema strictly.

properties.name: spring.ai.openrouter.chat.response-format.schema
properties.description: JSON schema document for a JSON schema format.
